summary: E-Power Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register and sell 3,600,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.55 per share, a 15.4% discount to the $0.65 closing price on May 20, 2026. The offering is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5) and General Instruction I.B.5 of Form F-3, limited to one-third of public float. The Cayman Islands holding company, with VIE-structured Chinese operations, is not subject to any special-situation event. This is an ordinary capital-raising transaction, not a special situation, so no special-situation analysis applies.
